meta.themes: Funding, Builder Tools, Infrastructure, Policy, Markets

news.title: OpenAI announced a $110 billion funding round backed by Amazon, Nvidia, and SoftBank
news.summary: Reuters reported OpenAI raised a new mega-round that values the company at $840 billion, signaling continued hyperscaler and semiconductor concentration around top model platforms.

news.title: OpenAI reached a deal to deploy AI models on a U.S. Defense Department classified network
news.summary: Reuters said OpenAI entered a classified-network deployment arrangement with the U.S. Department of War, highlighting faster institutional adoption of frontier AI in national-security contexts.

news.title: Anthropic said it would not remove safeguards in its Pentagon dispute
news.summary: Reuters reported Anthropic refused Pentagon requests to weaken model safeguards, keeping safety boundaries as a core position amid defense demand.

news.title: OpenAI selected London as its largest research hub outside the U.S.
news.summary: Reuters covered OpenAI's UK expansion move, indicating stronger geographic diversification of frontier-model research and talent concentration.

news.title: AI firms were reported to be channeling billions into compute and data center expansion
news.summary: Reuters described broad infrastructure acceleration across model developers and chip vendors as demand for training and inference capacity continued to climb.

news.title: White House scheduled talks with major tech firms after power-cost pledge
news.summary: Reuters reported U.S. officials planned meetings with large AI and data-center operators after voluntary commitments aimed at reducing electricity price pressure on ratepayers.

news.title: Nvidia reportedly prepared a new chip aimed at faster AI processing
news.summary: Reuters, citing the Wall Street Journal, said Nvidia was planning a processor focused on higher AI efficiency for major model and cloud customers.

news.title: Wall Street extended a tech-led rally as AI jitters eased
news.summary: Reuters said U.S. equities pushed higher on improved AI sentiment ahead of major chip earnings, reinforcing the market's sensitivity to AI execution signals.

news.title: U.S. stocks weakened after Nvidia results as investors debated AI momentum
news.summary: Reuters reported a pullback in major indexes despite strong Nvidia numbers, showing that valuation pressure and expectations remain high.

news.title: GitHub Copilot CLI became generally available with MCP server support
news.summary: GitHub announced general availability of Copilot CLI for subscribers, including built-in support for GitHub's MCP server and custom MCP server connections.

news.title: GitHub made Copilot metrics generally available, including CLI activity
news.summary: GitHub shipped GA usage metrics for Copilot with enterprise-level visibility into CLI requests and adoption trends.

news.title: VS Code 1.110 Insiders expanded agent plugin installation options
news.summary: The February VS Code Insiders release added support for installing agent plugins from private GitHub repositories and direct Git URLs.
